subject: patient1
description: SCAT v1: pure wavelet scattering front-end. 1st-order log-energy in Morlet filterbank (Q1=12, 7 oct, fmax=8000) at 4 averaging windows (512/1024/2048/4096); across-frame 2nd-order time scattering (Morlet at 1.5,3,6,10,14 Hz on each lambda1 channel); joint-TF 2D Morlet scattering (16 (rate,scale) pairs) on the (T, lambda1) log-cochleagram.

subject: patient1
description: SCAT v2: Hann-windowed FFT. 1st-order Morlet log-scattering (Q1=12, 7 oct, fmax=8000) -> 84 ch. WITHIN-WINDOW 2nd-order AM scattering: analytic envelope via complex ifft of one-sided Morlet * X, rfft of |env|, projected onto 2nd Morlet bank (Q2=1, n_oct2 from 6Hz floor to 1024Hz) -> 84*n_lambda2 ch. ACROSS-FRAME slow AM scattering on S1 at 1.5,3,6,10,14 Hz -> 84*5 ch.

subject: patient1
description: SCAT v3: multi-window 1st-order (512/1024/2048/4096) + within-window 2nd-order AM scattering + extended across-frame Morlet (0.75-14 Hz) + per-band transient HWR(+/-) at lags 1,2,4,8,16 + broadband loudness onset/offset HWR.

subject: patient1
description: SCAT v4: SCAT-v3 (0.0585) + joint-TF 2D Morlet scattering on long S1 with 16 (rate,scale) kernels covering syllabic/prosodic temporal rates × up/down spectral sweep directions, plus per-kernel mean over channels.

subject: patient1
description: SCAT v5: SCAT-v3 base (0.0585), drop joint-TF (no gain). ADD adaptation: log_S1 - lowpass(log_S1, tau=15,60,150 frames) on long S1 and Q=4 multi-Q 1st-order. Q=4, 7-oct broader-band Morlet bank also adds a parallel 1st-order view with looser frequency / better time.

subject: patient1
description: SCAT v6: SCAT-v5 (0.0650) + acausal lowpass adaptation (future-context at tau=15,60 frames), Q=4 broader-band transients (HWR at lags 1,2,4,8). Dropped cube-root path for memory.

subject: patient1
description: SCAT v7: SCAT-v6 (0.0656) + SPECTRAL normalization on long S1 (de-DC per frame across band axis), DoG lateral inhibition at 2 scales, and acausal high-pass on across-frame 2nd order.

subject: patient1
description: SCAT v8: restore SCAT-v6 acausal adaptation (0.0656 base) + bump Q2 from 1 to 2 for finer AM rate resolution in within-window 2nd-order scattering (14 lambda2 bins instead of 7, still pooled across 24 lambda1 groups).

subject: patient1
description: SCAT v9: SCAT-v8 base (0.0655) + harmonic-stacking F0 detection on long power (11 F0 candidates, 10 harmonics, multi-tau dynamics on best F0 + strength), + waveform-level features (zero-crossing rate, crest factor, log, multi-tau dynamics). Cheap features that scattering itself misses.

subject: patient1
description: SCAT v10: SCAT-v9 base (0.0657). NEW: phase-locking value (PLV) features derived from the analytic envelopes already computed for within-window 2nd order. Per-band |mean_z| (voicing strength via phase concentration), PLV between adjacent bands (k=1), PLV between octave-separated bands (k=12). Dropped F0 dynamics and waveform ZCR/crest (gave +0.0001 only) to fit memory.

subject: patient1
description: SCAT v11: SCAT-v9 base (0.0657). NEW: multi-window 2nd-order — short-window (1024 samples = 23ms) within-window AM scattering at Q2=2, pooled to 16 lambda1 groups × n_lambda2_short bins. Captures fast AM with finer time resolution than the long-window (4096) 2nd order. Drop PLV (didn't help). Keep |mean_z| (voicing strength).

subject: patient1
description: SCAT v12: drop short-window 2nd-order (no help in v11). ADD high-Q narrow-band Q=24, 6-oct 1st-order Morlet bank at long window + short-tau (1.5, 4.5 frames) adaptation on standard Q=12 S1. Targets pitch harmonic resolution.

subject: patient1
description: SCAT v13: SCAT-v12 (0.0658) + 3RD-ORDER scattering. Apply across-frame Morlet bank (rates 1.5, 4, 8 Hz) to within-window 2nd-order output (S2_pool), in two slicings: mean-over-lambda1 (per-AM-rate) and mean-over-lambda2 (per-band). Captures syllabic-rate modulation of within-window AM spectrum (e.g., pitch energy varying with syllabic rhythm).

subject: patient1
description: SCAT v14: SCAT-v13 (0.0660). Shift F_MAX from 8000 to 12000 Hz (keep 7 oct, Q=12, n_lambda1=84). Spectral range now ~79-12000 Hz vs 52-8000 — gains sibilant content (s, sh, f) up to 12 kHz; loses sub-79 Hz coverage.

subject: patient1
description: SCAT v15: revert F_MAX to 8000 (12000 cost 0.0006). ADD soft-argmax formant tracking: 3 band-groups (F1/F2/F3 ranges), location+amplitude per group, diffs (F2-F1, F3-F2), multi-tau dynamics (4.5/15/60), velocity HWR. Classical speech feature scattering misses.

subject: patient1
description: SCAT v16: SCAT-v15 (0.0665) + closed-form spectral summaries: 4-moment (log centroid/log spread/skew/kurt), spectral flatness, rolloff @0.85/0.95, HNR via ACF peak (75-400Hz), phonetic templates (sibilant/vowel/nasal/plosive/fricative) + multi-tau dynamics on these 1D signals.

subject: patient1
description: SCAT v17: instantaneous-frequency (IF) / phase-derivative scattering. Per long-window analytic band, env-weighted phase derivative sin_phi[n] = imag(y[n] conj(y[n-1])) / (|y[n]||y[n-1]|) is computed; pool to 24 groups giving (center, voicing magnitude, std) = 72 dim. ALSO take 2nd-order Morlet bank of env-weighted IF signal (FM-rate spectrum), pool to 8 groups x 14 lambda2 = 112 dim. Drops cube-root path + 2048 window + ONSET_LAG k=1 to fit memory. Base = SCAT-v16 (0.0666).

subject: patient1
description: SCAT v18: extend the IF win. Drop S3_a/S3_b 3rd-order scattering (114 dim, modest contributor). EXPAND FM-rate pooling from 8 to 14 band groups x 14 lambda2 = 196 dim (was 112). ADD short-window (W=1024) IF stats: per-band sin_phi center/mag/std, pooled to 16 groups x 3 = 48 dim — captures fast pitch/formant motion at finer time resolution. Base = SCAT-v17 (0.0672).

subject: patient1
description: SCAT v19: revert v18 extensions (short-window IF + finer FM-rate hurt). Keep S3 dropped (v18 baseline). ADD HARMONIC PHASE COHERENCE (HPC): for each F0 candidate, check whether the IF of the band nearest k*F0 equals k*IF_1 (true for harmonics). Voicing-weighted phase coherence of residuals = phi_k - k*phi_1 across K=10 harmonics gives a per-F0 pitched-source detector. 11 F0 candidates x 2 stats = 22 dim, plus 3 multi-tau dynamics = 88 dim total. Built entirely from already-computed if_center_mag — almost free. Base = SCAT-v17 (0.0672).

subject: patient1
description: SCAT v20: SCAT-v17 base (0.0672) + DIVISIVE-NORMALIZATION (lateral-contrast) cochleagram. E_contrast = log(E / Gaussian_smooth_across_bands(E)), sigma=3 bands. Captures formant PEAK PROMINENCE directly, independent of broadband loudness. Cortical-style divisive normalization applied across the tonotopic axis. 84 new dim only (v20a OOM with adapt). ~3008 dim/frame total.

subject: patient1
description: SCAT v21: extend v20 (0.0673) — MULTI-SCALE divisive-normalization cochleagram. sigma=2 (sharp formant peaks, narrow neighborhood) and sigma=8 (broad spectral-cluster contrast, octave-wide neighborhood). Two contrast cochleagrams = 168 dim. ~3092 dim/frame total.

subject: patient1
description: SCAT v22: SCAT-v20 (0.0673) + TEMPORAL divisive normalization: log(E[t] / lowpass_linear(E, tau=30 frames)). Differs from existing subtractive log-domain adaptation by Jensen's gap — the linear-domain mean is biased toward loud transients, so the contrast is more sensitive to peaks. 84 new dim, ~3092 dim/frame total.

subject: patient1
description: SCAT v23: SCAT-v20 (0.0673) + ACROSS-FRAME MODULATION SCATTERING on the contrast cochleagram (E_contrast pooled to 24 bands, then Morlet bank at 1.5/4/8/14 Hz). Captures the slow temporal modulation of formant prominence — combining divisive normalization with modulus scattering. 24*3 = 72 new dim, ~3080 dim/frame total.

subject: patient1
description: SCAT v24: SCAT-v20 (0.0673) + GROUP-DELAY-PER-BAND. Power-weighted avg group delay per Morlet band, computed via rfft(n*x): tells us whether the band's energy is concentrated EARLY (sharp onset), LATE (offset), or CENTERED (sustained) within the W-sample window. Adds the temporal centroid of energy per band — a piece of phase-derived information magnitude scattering throws away. 84 new dim, ~3092 dim/frame total.

subject: patient1
description: SCAT v25: SCAT-v20 (0.0673) + per-band ENVELOPE CUMULANTS (skewness and kurtosis of |y_j[tau]| within long window). Captures BURSTINESS vs sustained character per band — sharp plosives have high skew/kurt; sustained vowels have low. Magnitude scattering's lowpass averaging throws these higher moments away. Pool to 24 band groups × 2 stats = 48 new dim. ~3056 dim/frame total.

subject: patient1
description: SCAT v26: SCAT-v25 (0.0678) + LOG-envelope cumulants (skew, kurt of log(|y_j[tau]|) within long window). Different perceptual compression vs the linear cumulants in v25 — log-domain emphasizes low-amplitude structure. Pool to 16 band groups × 2 = 32 new dim. ~3088 dim/frame.

subject: patient1
description: SCAT v27: revert v26 log-env cumulants (no gain). SCAT-v25 (0.0678) + ADAPTATION on envelope-cumulant features: env_cum - lowpass(env_cum, tau=30 frames). Captures the RATE OF CHANGE of burstiness/asymmetry per band — when a sound transitions from sustained to bursty (e.g. fricative onset), this signal spikes. Adaptation applied to skew channel only (24 dim) to fit memory. ~3080 dim/frame.

subject: patient1
description: SCAT v28: SCAT-v27 (0.0684) + MULTI-TAU adaptation on env_cumulants (both skew AND kurt) at taus 15 and 60 frames. Captures fast (500 ms) and slow (2 s) burstiness changes per band. Replaces v27's single-tau single-channel adapt (24 dim) with 4-channel (2 taus × skew+kurt = 96 dim). Drop S1 tau=4.5 short adapt (-84 dim) to fit memory. ~3068 dim.

subject: patient1
description: SCAT v29: SCAT-v28 (0.0687) + ACAUSAL multi-tau adaptation on env_cumulants at taus 15 and 60 (in addition to v28's causal multi-tau). subject: patient1
description: SCAT v30: SCAT-v29 (0.0694) + EXTEND multi-tau cumulant adapt to tau=150 (5 s context) for causal AND acausal. Three center-surround time scales: 500ms / 2s / 5s. Drop S2_across rate 14 Hz (-84 dim) to make room. ~3092 dim/frame.

subject: patient1

subject: patient1
description: SCAT v32: SCAT-v31 (0.0704) + MULTI-TAU CAUSAL+ACAUSAL adapt on E_contrast (divisive-norm cochleagram) at tau=30. Applies the recipe that won for env_cumulants. +168 dim (2 × 84). Drop S2_across rates 6/10 (-168 dim) to make room. Net 0 dim change. ~3092 dim/frame.

subject: patient1

subject: patient1
